name: Twilio SMS
author: hearth-team
description: Send an SMS via Twilio. Configure once with Account SID + Auth Token + a 'from' number (Hearth enumerates your Twilio account-owned numbers and lets you pick); routines + the agent then dispatch.

vault_inputs.label: Account SID
vault_inputs.help: Find this in the Twilio Console: console.twilio.com → Account → API keys & tokens

vault_inputs.label: Auth Token
vault_inputs.help: Twilio's primary Auth Token from the same console page. Stored encrypted in the vault.

vault_inputs.label: From number
vault_inputs.help: Hearth lists your Twilio-owned numbers automatically after the SID + Token are saved. Pick the one to send from.
